role: Analytics Engineer to Business & Retail Banking
responsibilities: As an Analytics Engineer, you will create and maintain the data infrastructure, architecture and models that make digital behavioural data reliable, understandable and easy to use for analysis, reporting and emerging AI-enabled use cases.
You will translate business requirements into sustainable technical and data solutions, taking ownership from agreed requirements through implementation and production.

Your work will include designing scalable and cost-efficient transformation pipelines, developing event-based and cross-channel data models, and creating consistent definitions at event, session and user level.
You will also validate data, monitor quality, troubleshoot pipeline and data issues, and continuously improve maintainability, performance and cost.

An important part of the role is ensuring that datasets, metadata, documentation and business definitions are trustworthy and suitable for downstream consumption by analysts, business users and AI models.

Working in a modern cloud environment, you will contribute hands-on to solutions using technologies such as Google Cloud Platform with focus on BigQuery & Dataform, SQL, JavaScript, Terraform and Git-based development workflows.

You will support secure access management and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, analysts, engineers, architects and platform teams to deliver solutions that create measurable business value.
You will be part of building BRB’s cloud-based data and analytics platform and shaping new ways of working.
